theme: Light-themed identity dashboard inspired by KAVACH
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY meets PRECISION TACTICAL (Clean White background, Soft Mint Green active highlights, Deep Emerald & Obsidian accents)

layout_architecture.structure: Sidebar + Main Workspace + Right Profile Summary Column

sidebar.active_state_style: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 font-semibold border-r-4 border-emerald-500 shadow-sm

hero_card.bg: bg-slate-950 text-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl border border-slate-800 relative
hero_card.overlay_effect: Green neon biometric reticle grid, corner target brackets, pulsing scan beam, text badge 'Face Recognition'
hero_card.cta_button: bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg hover:shadow-emerald-500/25 transition-all

layout_architecture.right_column: w-full lg:w-80 flex flex-col gap-5 border-l border-slate-200 pl-0 lg:pl-6

vault_citizen.title: Citizen Vault Portal
components: Profile Identity Card with Face Match Status (Verified Badge)
Active Sharing Consents table with One-Click Revoke action
Document Vault cards (Aadhaar/National ID, Passport, Driver License, Tax ID) with status pills
Security Settings: Biometric Multi-Factor toggle, Account Deletion & Data Wipe request modal

nexus_business.title: Nexus Business Verification Workspace
components: Verification QR Code Wizard (Purpose, Required Claims checkboxes, Expiry timer, Usage limit)
Interactive QR Code Preview Card (PNG Download, Copy Link, WhatsApp Share link generator)
Private Remarks, Tags, and Task checklist per QR Code
Verification Analytics Dashboard Stats (Total Scans, Verified, Drop-offs, Avg Match Speed)

sentinel_government.title: Sentinel Government Oversight Portal
components: Access Reason Declaration Modal (Mandatory audit log before viewing case files)
Case Review List & Detailed Dossier view
Suspicious Activity Alert Feed with risk score indicators & complete Immutable Audit Log

public_verification_consent.title: Public Recipient Verification & Consent Screen
components: Explicit Data Share checkboxes (Name, Face Embedding Match, Age > 21, Document Hash)
Grant Consent (Face Scan to Confirm) & Deny buttons

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the KAVACH design aesthetic: clean white background, light gray borders, emerald green active highlights, dark biometric scanning cards.
Add explicit data-testid attributes on every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, menu items, table rows). Example: data-testid='start-scanning-btn', data-testid='tab-vault-individual'.
Ensure navigation bar/sidebar links use soft mint active backgrounds (bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 font-semibold).
Implement FaceGate camera capture with smooth animated overlay (green target grid, scanning beam effect).
Provide seamless role tab switching (Individual / Business / Government) to navigate between Vault, Nexus, and Sentinel views.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized with Tailwind classes for forms, modals, tables, toasts (Sonner), and popovers.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or full screen dark gradients outside of hero/scan cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Ensure micro-interactions on buttons, hover states, and list transitions.
